description.content: This resource allows partners to access their users' daily activity data. Webhooks are used to notify partners when new data is available.

List users activities available in AccessLink. When no date range is given, activities from the last 28 days are returned. When `from` is given, activities for the specified date range are returned. From date cannot be older than 365 days from today and the maximum range between from and to is 28 days.

query.description: Start date in format YYYY-MM-DD. If not given, defaults to 28 days ago.
End date in format YYYY-MM-DD. If not given, defaults to today.
